ticks.note: Tick 1 enters `Waiting` in both machines. A drink costs 30 cents.

A 20c coin. `Vending`: `credit += 20`, then straight on through the connector `Check` in the same tick; `credit >= 30` is false, so its untriggered transition goes back to `Waiting`. `VendingWithout`: the guard `coin20 && credit + 20 >= 30` is false, so its second transition adds the coin. `credit` = 20 in both.

A 10c coin. `Vending`: `credit` becomes 30, and `Check` sees the new value at once, so it takes the price off and emits `vend`. `VendingWithout`: the guard `credit + 10 >= 30` works out the new credit in advance and holds, so one transition does all of it. Same result in both: `vend`, and `credit` = 0.
`vend` is a signal, so it is present only in the tick it was emitted.
Both coins in one tick. In both charts the 20c transitions come first in `Waiting`'s priority order, so the 10c coin is ignored. 20 + 20 = 40: both machines vend and keep 10c.
Back in `Waiting` with 10c of credit, in both.
